Package com.agrialert.viewmodel

Class FieldsViewModel

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.viewmodel.FieldsViewModel
public class FieldsViewModel extends Object
ViewModel for managing agricultural fields and field groups. Provides a high-level API for UI components to perform CRUD operations and manage temporary field states during the creation process.
